summary: Off-registry HTTPS dependency pulls unpinned third-party tarball at install
details: package.json declares its sole dependency as a direct HTTPS URL (https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/plugin-client-queue-field) rather than a registry version range, with no version pin and no integrity hash. On npm install, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL currently returns and installs them, executing any lifecycle scripts the fetched tarball contains. The shipped index.js is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the manifest line is effectively the entire published surface of the package. The host artifacts.creditslib.com is unrelated to any registry or declared publisher, and the content it serves can be changed at any time without a package republish.
